purpose: Cheap SPY signal-level bootstrap. No options-edge claim and no broker action.

common.negativeEventGap: SPY 09:30 ET open <= prior RTH close by at least 0.20%
common.episodeSelection: Maximum one episode per event day; first qualifying signal only.

S001_FAILED_NEWS_BREAKDOWN.vwapFailure: A bar closes below session VWAP after its high reaches within 0.10% of VWAP.
S001_FAILED_NEWS_BREAKDOWN.priceConfirmation: The next 5-minute bar remains below VWAP and closes below the failure bar close.
S001_FAILED_NEWS_BREAKDOWN.directionalReturn: Positive when SPY falls after entry.

S002_FAILED_NEWS_REVERSAL.openingExtremeHolds: No new session low is printed after 09:45 before the VWAP reclaim.
S002_FAILED_NEWS_REVERSAL.vwapReclaim: A bar closes above session VWAP after the immediately prior bar closed at or below VWAP.
S002_FAILED_NEWS_REVERSAL.priceConfirmation: The next 5-minute bar remains above VWAP and closes at or above the reclaim-bar close.
S002_FAILED_NEWS_REVERSAL.directionalReturn: Positive when SPY rises after entry.

bootstrapPassGate.note: If fewer than eight episodes occur, result is INSUFFICIENT rather than PASS. Any extension uses the identical frozen rule.

antiOverfitRule: No thresholds may be changed after performance inspection. Any material change requires a new version.
